rationale: process_issue_inplace() already implements precondition-check/early-return with failure_reason twice (learning gate, blocked-issue check); Option A is a third instance of that established pattern. Option B's reactive re-check-and-conditionally-proceed logic and one-shot local-boolean bound have no precedent in this file and cost a full extra LLM pass per sub-threshold issue.
rule: Option A: Skip-only remedy for the ll-auto confidence gate
alternatives_rejected: Option B: Remediate via synchronous /ll:confidence-check + re-check, mirroring autodev.yaml's FSM marker-file-bounded remediate-then-recheck shape
